name: openpixo/sprite-walk-8dir
title: 8-direction walk animation
description: Step 2 of a walk animation: animates an 8-direction walk sheet into one smooth looping walk per direction, as transparent frames and an engine sprite sheet.

description_i18n.en: Step 2 of a walk animation: animates an 8-direction walk sheet into one smooth looping walk per direction, as transparent frames and an engine sprite sheet.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 行走动画第 2 步：把 8 方向行走姿势图做成每个方向一段流畅循环的行走，导出透明帧和引擎精灵图。

recipe.whenToUse: Second step of an 8-direction walk: animate a walk sheet from sprite-walk-sheet-8dir into a looping walk for every direction.
recipe.prompt:
A 2D game sprite sheet on a flat green screen: eight copies of the same character in two rows of four. Each copy does a walk cycle in place, as if on a treadmill that runs in the direction that copy is facing. Each copy keeps its head, chest and hips pointing in its own starting direction for the whole clip: no copy turns, twists, leans or rotates, and none moves out of its spot.

How each copy steps:
Top row, first (facing the camera): walks straight toward the camera. Its legs move forward and back toward the viewer, so on screen each foot moves up and down: the stepping foot lands a little lower in the frame and the back foot lifts behind. Knees stay under the hips and never spread sideways; the feet stay hip-width apart.
Top row, second (facing down-right): walks diagonally toward the bottom-right of the screen. The stepping foot reaches toward the bottom-right corner; the stride runs along that diagonal, not across the screen.
Top row, third (facing right, side profile): a classic side-view walk; legs swing forward and back, which is left-right on screen.
Top row, fourth (facing up-right, seen from behind): walks away diagonally toward the top-right. The stepping foot reaches toward the top-right corner; the stride runs along that diagonal.
Bottom row, first (back to the camera): walks straight away from the camera. Each foot moves up and down on screen: the stepping foot lands a little higher in the frame, the back foot lifts and shows its sole. Knees stay under the hips and never spread sideways.
Bottom row, second (facing up-left, seen from behind): walks away diagonally toward the top-left; the stride runs along that diagonal.
Bottom row, third (facing left, side profile): a classic side-view walk; legs swing left-right on screen.
Bottom row, fourth (facing down-left): walks diagonally toward the bottom-left; the stride runs along that diagonal.

All copies: arms swing opposite to the legs, the body bobs slightly up on each passing step, loose cloth sways a little. All eight step in sync. The clip starts mid-stride with every copy's left foot forward, passes through the right foot forward halfway, and ends back in the exact starting pose: exactly one full stride. No copy ever stands still or brings its feet together.

Locked static camera, no zoom, no pan. Flat solid chroma-green background the whole time. Same design, colours and size in every frame. No new objects, no text, no shadows.
